To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the context information captured from the user’s mobile behavior can be used to adapt the enterprise service to the user, and this adaptation can be done in three tiers: user interface views (UIV), data views (DV), and process views (PV).
we propose a new paradigm for context-aware ubiquitous service adaptation based on the notion of extended context.
ubiquitous enterprise services should be adapted to the context of mobile users in order to improve their usability and accessibility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of a context-aware enterprise information system that can adapt to the user’s context in order to provide a more personalized, flexible, and efficient service.
the design of ubiquitous enterprise services, which are adapted based on the context-aware user behavior.
the design and development of ubiquitous enterprise service adaptation based on contextual user behaviors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ubiquitous enterprise information system (EIS) should be context-aware, and that context-awareness should be incorporated into the EIS design and implementation process from the early stage of requirements elicitation and analysis.
the proposed methodology and model provide a systematic approach to the development of ubiquitous enterprise applications.
ubiquitous enterprise information systems should be designed and implemented based on a three-tier model of user interface views, process views, and data views.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the context-awareness of a mobile system is achieved by a systematic design and implementation of the context-awareness features.
the ubiquitous service adaptation model and the process views are useful for designing context-aware applications in a systematic and structured manner.

the proposed approach provides a systematic methodology for designing context-aware enterprise service adaptations, and the process view provides an effective way to integrate different types of adaptation requirements and to implement the context-aware adaptations in an efficient way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the notion of process views is an effective mechanism for ubiquitous service adaptations and can be easily integrated with other views.
the notion of process views is an effective way for the integration of context-awareness into enterprise applications and for the design of ubiquitous service adaptations.
context-awareness is not just an add-on feature to existing systems but a paradigm shift for the development of ubiquitous enterprise information systems.
